tasks.label: Build SPA
tasks.command: npx vite build

tasks.label: BACKEND
tasks.command: until pg_isready -h postgres -p 5432 -U dns_zone_manager -d dns_zone_manager 2>/dev/null; do echo 'Waiting for postgres (start the POSTGRES task if it is not running)...'; sleep 2; done && go run ./cmd/dns-zone-manager serve --config .devcontainer/config.devcontainer.yaml --ui-dir dist

tasks.label: Vite (optional)
tasks.command: npm run dev

tasks.label: BIND
tasks.command: proj="${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME:-dns-zone-manager-go_devcontainer}"; bind="${proj}-bind-1"; sudo docker compose -f .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml --project-name "$proj" up -d bind && sudo docker exec "$bind" mkdir -p /etc/bind/zones-source && sudo docker cp /workspace/.devcontainer/named.conf.devcontainer "${bind}:/etc/bind/named.conf" && sudo docker cp /workspace/examples/bind/zones/. "${bind}:/etc/bind/zones-source/" && sudo docker compose -f .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml --project-name "$proj" logs --tail 100 -f bind

tasks.label: POSTGRES
tasks.command: proj="${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME:-dns-zone-manager-go_devcontainer}"; sudo docker compose -f .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml --project-name "$proj" up -d postgres && sudo docker compose -f .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml --project-name "$proj" logs --tail 100 -f postgres

tasks.label: LGTM
tasks.command: proj="${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME:-dns-zone-manager-go_devcontainer}"; lgtm="${proj}-lgtm-1"; sudo docker compose -f .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml --project-name "$proj" up -d lgtm && ver="$(sudo docker exec "$lgtm" printenv GRAFANA_VERSION)" && sudo docker exec "$lgtm" mkdir -p /otel-lgtm/grafana/conf/provisioning/dashboards/custom && sudo docker cp /workspace/examples/observability/otelcol-config.yaml "${lgtm}:/otel-lgtm/otelcol-config.yaml" && sudo docker cp /workspace/examples/observability/dashboards/provisioning.yaml "${lgtm}:/otel-lgtm/grafana-v${ver}/conf/provisioning/dashboards/custom.yaml" && sudo docker cp /workspace/examples/observability/dashboards/dns-zone-manager.json "${lgtm}:/otel-lgtm/grafana/conf/provisioning/dashboards/custom/dns-zone-manager.json" && sudo docker cp /workspace/examples/observability/dashboards/performance.json "${lgtm}:/otel-lgtm/grafana/conf/provisioning/dashboards/custom/performance.json" && sudo docker restart "$lgtm" && echo '\nGrafana: http://localhost:3000  (Loki + metrics dashboards)\n' && sudo docker compose -f .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml --project-name "$proj" logs --tail 100 -f lgtm

tasks.label: ENTRA
tasks.command: export COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME="${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME:-dns-zone-manager-go_devcontainer}"; if [ -f /tmp/entra-themeproxy/proxy.pid ]; then kill "$(cat /tmp/entra-themeproxy/proxy.pid)" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; fuser -k 8444/tcp 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf /tmp/entra-themeproxy && mkdir -p /tmp/entra-themeproxy && go build -o /tmp/entra-themeproxy/proxy ./.devcontainer/entra/themeproxy && /tmp/entra-themeproxy/proxy > /tmp/entra-themeproxy/proxy.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/entra-themeproxy/proxy.pid && sudo docker compose -f .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml --project-name "$COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME" up -d --force-recreate entra && echo 'Waiting for Entra emulator (via dark theme proxy on :8444)…' && until curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8444/health >/dev/null; do sleep 1; done && curl -sf -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8444/admin/api/import -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @.devcontainer/entra/directory.json && echo && echo 'Entra emulator:  http://localhost:8444  (dark sign-in via themeproxy → :18445)' && echo 'Issuer:           http://localhost:8444/6f89cf12-978b-4d23-ac18-9ef0c127cf87/v2.0' && echo 'Dummy users:      user1@dns-zone-manager.test / pass1  (user2/pass2, user3/pass3)' && echo && sudo docker compose -f .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml --project-name "$COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME" logs --tail 100 -f entra

tasks.label: TRAEFIK
tasks.command: export COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME="${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME:-dns-zone-manager-go_devcontainer}"; until curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8444/health >/dev/null 2>&1; do echo 'Waiting for Entra emulator (start the ENTRA task if it is not running)...'; sleep 2; done && sudo docker compose -f .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml --project-name "$COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME" create oauth2-proxy >/dev/null && VOL="${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}_oauth2-templates" && SEED=$(sudo docker create -v "$VOL:/templates" alpine:3.20) && sudo docker cp .devcontainer/oauth2-proxy/sign_in.html "$SEED:/templates/sign_in.html" && sudo docker cp .devcontainer/oauth2-proxy/error.html "$SEED:/templates/error.html" && sudo docker cp .devcontainer/oauth2-proxy/robots.txt "$SEED:/templates/robots.txt" && sudo docker rm "$SEED" >/dev/null && sudo docker compose -f .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml --project-name "$COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME" up -d --force-recreate oauth2-proxy traefik && echo && echo 'App (OIDC):       http://localhost:8080' && echo 'Traefik dashboard: http://localhost:8081' && echo 'dns-cli auth login --url http://localhost:8080' && echo '  (user1@dns-zone-manager.test / pass1)' && echo && sudo docker compose -f .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml --project-name "$COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME" logs --tail 100 -f traefik oauth2-proxy

tasks.label: ZONE CHURN
tasks.command: BIND_HOST=bind BIND_PORT=15353 API_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:8000 API_KEY=dev INTERVAL_SEC=5 /workspace/examples/always-changing/churn.sh

tasks.label: PERF: Create 5M zone
tasks.command: API_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:8000 API_KEY=dev BIND_HOST=bind BIND_PORT=15353 ./perf.sh zone create --preset 5m

tasks.label: PERF: Run all
tasks.command: API_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:8000 API_KEY=dev BIND_HOST=bind BIND_PORT=15353 ./perf.sh run all

tasks.label: PERF: Destroy zone
tasks.command: API_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:8000 API_KEY=dev BIND_HOST=bind BIND_PORT=15353 ./perf.sh zone destroy --delete-file

tasks.label: Shutdown All
tasks.command:
echo '
📋 To stop all running services:

   Press Ctrl+Shift+P → "Terminal: Kill All Terminals"

   Or click the trash icon in each terminal panel.
'

tasks.label: Rebuild Dev Container
tasks.command:
echo '
📋 To rebuild the dev container:

   1. Stop services: Ctrl+Shift+P → "Terminal: Kill All Terminals"
   2. Rebuild: Ctrl+Shift+P → "Dev Containers: Rebuild Container"

This will rebuild the container image and restart all services.
'

tasks.label: Run All Tests
tasks.command: ./tests.sh

tasks.label: Run Backend Tests
tasks.command: go test ./...

tasks.label: Run Backend Unit Tests
tasks.command: go test ./internal/... ./cmd/...

tasks.label: Run Frontend Tests
tasks.command: npm run test

tasks.label: Run E2E Tests
tasks.command: npm run test:e2e

tasks.label: Lint All
tasks.command: golangci-lint run ./... && npm run lint

tasks.label: Format All
tasks.command: gofmt -w $(find . -name '*.go' -not -path './.git/*') && npm run format

tasks.label: Type Check
tasks.command: go vet ./... && npm run typecheck
